messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] mapping interval
parts:
I have very little idea what you mean by "mapping interval".
Perhaps (by "exclusionary window size") you mean the window in
composite interval mapping (CIM). If so, you can use the window
argument to the function cim().

karl
